description: Lists the Open Trivia Database quiz categories with their ids (e.g. 9 General Knowledge, 21 Sports, 22 Geography, 11 Film), so an agent can plan quiz rounds and pass a category to trivia_questions or trivia_true_false. Covers only the categories this database offers; it does not say how many questions each holds (use trivia_question_count). (cost: 1 credit)
name: trivia_categories
